d:
Pakistan ke jalvayu parivartan mantri musadik malik shanghaee sahyog sangthan (essio) ke pahle 'daylog of sivilaijeshans' men hissa lene ke lie shukravar, 20 navanbar ko dilli pahunche. sal 2023 ke bad bharat aane vale vah pakistan ke pahle kendriy mantri hain. halanki, bharat ki mukhy vipakshi parti kangres musadik malik ke bharat daure se khush nahin hai.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
